sentences.text: 2. The challenge in the present petition is to the notification dated 24.05.2018 whereby the State amendment by way of the Haryana Act No. 21 of 2018, Section 101-A of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement (Haryana Amendment Act) 2017, (for short the 'Act of 2017') was brought into force giving power to de-notify the land acquired for public purpose under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 (for short the 'Act of 1894') on the grounds of non-viability or non-essentiality.

sentences.text: However, the Act of 2017 was apparently given retrospective effect coming into force on 1st day of January 2014 which would be from the date of enforcement of the Principal Act, 2013 itself.
